raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

H3 pads its packed sequence to a multiple of 64 per Ulysses rank, so a 1280x704 request attends `cu_seqlens [0, 33002, 33024]`. cuDNN SDPA's varlen runs each segment as its own call, so every pipelined head group ran the real rows, a copy into the output, a cuDNN call for the 22 alignment rows and a second copy. With 7 groups per layer that is 28 extra launches and their host work per block.

## Modifications

- The alignment rows only ever reach their own rows (attention keeps them in their own segment, everything else is row-wise), so group attention now attends the real rows only, writes them straight into the output when the backend can (FA4), and zeroes the alignment rows. The real rows run the same call as before.
- Test added to `test_minimax_h3_dit_contract.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

Bit-identical output: MP4 md5 identical to main in every arm (4/4 on FA4, 4/4 forced-cuDNN).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

4x B300 (stand-in for B200), same protocol as the three-waves PR; measured on top of it:

| | 1280x704 | 1344x768 |
|---|---|---|
| three-waves | 26.55 s | 31.78 s |
| + this PR | 26.46 s (-0.10) | 31.63 s (-0.14) |

Together with three-waves, the 20-prompt 720p median goes 26.793 -> 26.517 s (-1.03%).

Note: this touches the same H3 pipelined-Ulysses block in `minimax_h3.py` as the ROCm Ulysses-pipeline PR; whichever lands second needs a small rebase.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit config (isort / ruff / black pass).
- [x] Add unit tests (merged into the existing test file for the touched area).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (above).

files.patch:
@@ -66,6 +66,9 @@
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.attention_backend import (
     AttentionRequirements,
 )
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.sdpa import (
+    DynamicCudnnSDPAImpl,
+)
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.video_sparse_attn_h3 import (
     vsa_h3_fold_gate,
 )
@@ -738,17 +741,56 @@ def _minimax_h3_pipelined_dense_attention(
         ulysses_pipelined_attention,
     )
 
+    attend = _minimax_h3_group_attend(
+        impl,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+        cu_seqlens_host=cu_seqlens_host,
+        max_seqlen=max_seqlen,
+    )
+    return ulysses_pipelined_attention(q, k, v, attend, groups, fill=fill)
+
+
+def _minimax_h3_group_attend(
+    impl,
+    *,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens_host: tuple[int, ...] | None,
+    max_seqlen: int,
+):
+    """One head group's attention over the gathered packed sequence.
+
+    Trailing alignment rows (cu_seqlens ``[0, used, total]``) only reach their
+    own rows, so they stay zero; the real rows run cuDNN SDPA varlen's own
+    per-segment call, written straight into the output when the backend can.
+    """
+    used = max_seqlen
+    pad_only_tail = (
+        isinstance(impl, DynamicCudnnSDPAImpl)
+        and cu_seqlens_host is not None
+        and len(cu_seqlens_host) == 3
+        and cu_seqlens_host[:2] == (0, used)
+        and cu_seqlens_host[2] > used
+    )
+
     def attend(q_group, k_group, v_group):
-        return impl.forward_varlen(
-            q_group,
-            k_group,
-            v_group,
-            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
-            max_seqlen=max_seqlen,
-            cu_seqlens_host=cu_seqlens_host,
-        )
+        if not pad_only_tail:
+            return impl.forward_varlen(
+                q_group,
+                k_group,
+                v_group,
+                cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+                max_seqlen=max_seqlen,
+                cu_seqlens_host=cu_seqlens_host,
+            )
+        out = torch.empty_like(q_group)
+        real = [t[:used].unsqueeze(0) for t in (q_group, k_group, v_group)]
+        dst = out[:used].unsqueeze(0)
+        if not impl.forward_into(*real, dst, None):
+            dst.copy_(impl.forward(*real, None))
+        out[used:].zero_()
+        return out
 
-    return ulysses_pipelined_attention(q, k, v, attend, groups, fill=fill)
+    return attend
 
 
 # aiter's varlen kernel gives a head group the same bytes as those heads inside

@@ -24,7 +24,10 @@
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.cube_sparse_attn import (
     CubeSparseAttentionBackend,
 )
-from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.sdpa import SDPAImpl
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.sdpa import (
+    DynamicCudnnSDPAImpl,
+    SDPAImpl,
+)
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.selector import (
     component_attn_backend_context_manager,
 )
@@ -46,6 +49,7 @@
     MiniMaxH3DiTModel,
     _copy_grouped_qkv_tp_shard,
     _diffusers_h3_checkpoint,
+    _minimax_h3_group_attend,
     _modulate_gate,
     _qkv_scale_block_rows,
     _reorder_grouped_qkv_to_qkv,
@@ -415,6 +419,31 @@ def test_cache_dit_out_of_place_gate_preserves_cuda_input():
     torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA")
+def test_group_attend_skips_only_the_trailing_alignment_rows():
+    """The pipelined Ulysses group attention gives the real rows the bytes of
+    forward_varlen and leaves the packing's alignment rows zero."""
+    used, total = 16400, 16448  # long enough for FA4 on sm_103
+    impl = DynamicCudnnSDPAImpl(
+        num_heads=2, head_size=128, causal=False, softmax_scale=128**-0.5
+    )
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    q, k, v = (
+        torch.randn(total, 2, 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        for _ in range(3)
+    )
+    bounds = (0, used, total)
+    kwargs = dict(
+        cu_seqlens=torch.tensor(bounds, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32),
+        cu_seqlens_host=bounds,
+        max_seqlen=used,
+    )
+    ref = impl.forward_varlen(q, k, v, **kwargs)
+    got = _minimax_h3_group_attend(impl, **kwargs)(q, k, v)
+    assert torch.equal(got[:used], ref[:used])
+    assert not got[used:].any()
+
+
 def test_tp_and_ulysses_admission_uses_tp_local_shapes():
     arch = MiniMaxH3DiTArchConfig()
     model = MiniMaxH3DiTModel.__new__(MiniMaxH3DiTModel)
